name: Unwanted Background Work
problem: Recurring background passes can work when the person's settings say they should not: past the daily budget, on a day outside the roster, or without a cadence being due.
who_has_it: People who set an autopilot cadence and budget for their quest.
why_it_matters: An autopilot that ignores its settings spends money and writes to a quest the person did not ask it to touch, which breaks the promise of the setting.
why_hard: The decision depends on budget, cadence, a pending run-now request, reactive triggers and a roster, and it has to be made before any goal is read or any model is called.
existing_attempts: A cron schedule, a global on or off switch, and per-run checks inside the pass.
